VSM implements Spout-compatible sender discovery and Direct3D 11 shared-texture
reception in Rust using the Windows APIs. The Spout2 implementation was used
as a reference for the shared-memory layout, object names, and synchronization
protocol. VSM does not link to or distribute the Spout SDK C++ library or DLL.
The reference implementation's copyright, license conditions, and disclaimer
are preserved in Spout-BSD-2-Clause.txt.

Reference files at the commit above:

SPOUTSDK/SpoutGL/SpoutSenderNames.cpp
SPOUTSDK/SpoutGL/SpoutSharedMemory.cpp
SPOUTSDK/SpoutGL/SpoutFrameCount.cpp

SPOUTSDK/SpoutDirectX/SpoutDX/SpoutDX.cpp
